sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Alok Agnihotri - Government Advocate for the applican  ORDER Heard on admission.

This is an application for seeking cancellation of bail earlier granted to the respondent vide order dated 07.01.2022 passed in M.Cr.C.No.64396/2021 in connection with Crime No.164/2021 registered at Police Station Bahrol District Sagar for the offence punishable under Sections 363,
366A and 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 3, 4,5 and 6 of POCSO Act.

Learned counsel for the State submits that another offence has been registered against the respondent vide Crime No.177/2024 at Police Station Bahrol, District Sagar for the offence punishable under Sections 115(2), 296 and 351(2) of the Bhartiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and therefore this application has been filed for cancellation of bail.
Indeed, this court in M.Cr.C.No.29008/2024 (State of Madhya Pradesh v. Rashid Khan @ Arif Khan) vide order dated 29.08.2024 has already laid NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:60577 2 MCRC-46632-2024 down the criterion, under which the bail can be cancelled.
